construction_spec.reason: RCC framed structure recommended for open spatial layout; load-bearing masonry is viable for single-story compact footprint.
assumptions: External perimeter walls configured as 9.0" (229mm) masonry for weatherproofing.
Internal partition walls configured as 4.5" (114mm) space-saving masonry.
Floor-to-floor vertical rise of 10.5' provides 9.5' clear head room after MEP/false ceiling drops.
Reinforced concrete slab assumed at 5.5" thickness with grade M20/M25 concrete.
Quality standard tier: Standard finishes and construction tolerances.
construction_spec.disclaimer: Preliminary planning recommendation — verify with licensed structural engineer before construction.

itemized_details.column_reinforcement_note: Assumption-based preliminary allowance (final schedule requires structural-engineer verification).
structural_assumptions: Structural system assumption: RCC Frame with 5.5 in solid slab.
Column count: 33 columns positioned along structural walls and envelope.
Preliminary beam count: 44 beams connecting column grid nodes.
Clearance verified: Zero column obstruction of door openings, stairs, and parking.
Multi-floor alignment: Columns stack continuously from ground to top floor.

items.item_name: Internal 12mm & External 18mm double-coat weatherproof plaster
items.assumption: Internal 12mm & external 18mm plaster (654.9 m²) | Ref: CPWD DSR 2023 Item 13.1 & 13.11

items.item_name: Terrace & wet room elastomeric membrane waterproofing
items.assumption: Terrace, balcony and wet areas waterproofing | Ref: Specialist Waterproofing Agency Schedule

items.item_name: Vitrified tiles / Italian marble / Granite flooring with skirting
items.assumption: Floor tiles / stone with skirting (101.1 m²) | Ref: Kajaria / Somany / Imported Marble Index

items.item_name: Factory-finished flush / teakwood doors and UPVC / aluminum windows

items.assumption: Granite counter platform with SS sink & dado | Ref: Kitchen Contractor Schedule

items.assumption: Sanitary fittings, EWC, CP taps (11 points) | Ref: Jaquar / Kohler / Hindware Market Schedule

items.assumption: Concealed copper modular wiring (88 points) | Ref: Havells / Legrand / Polycab Rate List

items.assumption: 3-chamber septic tank with soak pit | Ref: Sanitary Drainage Standard Rates

items.assumption: Masonry compound wall with steel gate (61.0 running meters) | Ref: State PWD External Works Schedule
